transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me in the workshop today. As many of you know, I've been asked to restore a worn 1920s community cookbook. The book has a detached cover and several loose pages, so it will need careful attention. Before I decide whether to accept this commission and set the final terms, I'd like to hear from each of you. As is our usual practice, please state any terms, offers, or material constraints you know of that might bear on this work. That way I can make a fully informed decision.
